title: Zhao et al. 2026, Ultra-thin cerium-doped indium oxide TCO films with high carrier mobility (JMSE 37:1273)
notes: Deposition is reactive plasma deposition (RPD), not magnetron sputtering; fields are filled as for sputtering.
Films: 100 nm ITO, 100 nm ICO, 30 nm ICO at 0.6% and 1% H2; each as-deposited and annealed (180 °C, 50 min, air).
Carrier transport speed (14.6 / 49 mm/s) is a linear speed, not a rotation_speed.
No substrate heating is used (no number); base pressure 4e-5 Pa is not a working pressure.
Table 1 rows other than 'ICO (this work)' are literature values.
O2/H2 percentages are shares of the reactive gas; the paper does not say relative to what.
